associations.evidence_summary: John Paul II's 1992 apostolic letter elevates Maria Radna church to basilica minor and cites pilgrim visits from neighboring dioceses.
associations.qualification: Papal decree proves basilica title, not exact door coordinates or an apparition event.

associations.evidence_summary: Capuchin custodians identify an active sanctuary of Blessed Jeremiah the Wallachian in Onești.
associations.qualification: Separate from Capuchin convent building; exact Place and crypt relation need review.

associations.evidence_summary: Capuchin friars report the Blessed Jeremiah's relics deposited in the sanctuary crypt in 2008.
associations.qualification: Custodian account only; no independent authentication or future public access assertion.

associations.evidence_summary: Romanian Catholic diocesan account reports consecration of new eparchial Marian sanctuary at Scăiuș on 27 September 2014.
associations.qualification: New sanctuary building not necessarily identical with old village chapel; no date schedule.

associations.evidence_summary: Slovak tourism describes Marianka's historic Marian pilgrimage and Nativity celebration.
associations.qualification: Source is national tourism; confirm modern site custodian and original Marian image status.

associations.evidence_summary: Presov Greek-Catholic archieparchy identifies Ľutina as leading Byzantine Catholic pilgrim destination.
associations.qualification: Basilica and monastery are a complex; separate building identity requires geospatial source.

associations.evidence_summary: Archieparchy recounts reported 1851 manifestations of Saint Nicholas associated with Zuzana Fekete.
associations.qualification: Do not treat a historical eparchial narrative as a documented modern supernatural authenticity ruling.

associations.evidence_summary: Archieparchy locates regular pilgrimages at Holy Cross church in Buková Hôrka complex, also with a separate Transfiguration chapel.
associations.qualification: Do not create two canonical shrine buildings without separately verified physical identities.

associations.evidence_summary: Presov archieparchy traces pilgrimage to Basilian monastery and Marian icon; old monastery was ruined and rebuilt as a distinct new complex.
associations.qualification: Historical legends of healings are not independently verified miracles.

associations.evidence_summary: Archieparchy describes revered icon of Mother of God in chapel by Krásny Brod monastery church.
associations.qualification: Custody of original versus exact historical or copied icon requires image/object identity check.

associations.evidence_summary: Presov archieparchy includes Čirč among regional eparchial pilgrimage destinations.
associations.qualification: Exact named chapel/building and present parish legal identity not yet certified.

associations.evidence_summary: Presov archieparchy lists Rafajovce as an eparchial pilgrimage destination linked to a Marian icon.
associations.qualification: Legendary survival from a village fire must not be presented as verified miracle.

associations.evidence_summary: Presov archieparchy discusses local Marian icon and long-standing folk historical narratives.
associations.qualification: Icon's material provenance and history still await independent record review.

associations.evidence_summary: Presov archieparchy names Šašová in its catalogue of Byzantine Catholic pilgrimages.
associations.qualification: Site identity still at locality level; avoid inventing precise church entrance.

associations.evidence_summary: Slovak Greek-Catholic metropolitan record names Klokočov Marian shrine with reported 17th-century icon phenomenon.
associations.qualification: No precise historic original-icon custody assumed without custodial text.

associations.evidence_summary: Metropolitan church recounts reported tears from a Marian icon around 1670 at Klokočov.
associations.qualification: Historical church narrative is distinct from visual apparition or independent scientific verification.

associations.evidence_summary: Presov archieparchy and DDF identify Mount Zvir as pilgrimage destination; the Holy See granted nihil obstat in July 2025.
associations.qualification: Nihil obstat permits public cult but does NOT affirm supernatural authenticity of alleged apparitions.

associations.evidence_summary: DDF evaluates reported experiences of Mary at Mount Zvir in 1990–95.
associations.qualification: DDF rejected or qualified some ambiguous messages; supernatural authenticity NOT recognized.

associations.evidence_summary: Swedish Catholic diocese organizes annual Rosary pilgrimage to St Mary's Church at Oskarström; 2026 edition documented.
associations.qualification: 2026 route and timing must not be copied as a standing current schedule.

associations.evidence_summary: Parish-hosted diocesan rosary walk culminates in Mass, Marian devotion and sacramental blessing.
associations.qualification: Swedish local event, not a universal or French-world domestic custom.

associations.evidence_summary: Mariavall Benedictine abbey records annual pilgrimage around St Benedict's feast in July.
associations.qualification: Custodian site and pilgrim feast association; no current 2027 schedule inferred.

associations.evidence_summary: Church of Sweden organized 2026 walking pilgrimage from Mariavall to the historic Saint Olof church.
associations.qualification: Current church is Lutheran-run and must not be labeled Catholic-owned.

associations.evidence_summary: Finnish Catholic diocese describes Holy Cross pilgrimage to Hattula's medieval church around September.
associations.qualification: Catholic pilgrims visit historic building now administered outside Catholic Church.

associations.evidence_summary: Finnish Catholic diocese mentions veneration of a relic of the Holy Cross at Hattula pilgrimage.
associations.qualification: Description does not establish permanent custody by current Lutheran host.

associations.evidence_summary: Finnish Catholic diocese recounts Saint Henry's remains transferred to Turku Cathedral in AD 1300.
associations.qualification: Present Lutheran Turku Cathedral cannot be assumed to hold the entire ancient reliquary.

associations.evidence_summary: Estonian Catholic parish traces medieval pilgrimage to Holy Cross chapel site at Vanamõisa and staged 2025/2026 walks.
associations.qualification: Ruined/disappeared chapel location is not a functioning Catholic church or surviving Black Cross object.

associations.qualification: 2026 exploratory walking-route stages do not support an exact GPX line.

associations.evidence_summary: Archeparchy reports Marian image at Dormition church in historic Krylos.

governance: One physical site, one Place. Related source-backed relics, pilgrimages, devotional image objects and reported apparitions are separate associations, not duplicate Place entries.
The historic destruction, rebuilding or confessional change of a chapel does not demonstrate a current active Catholic-owned building; historical ownership is explicit.
Greek/Romanian/Ukrainian Catholic communities remain Catholic, but their local liturgical and customary practices are not automatically French Latin Catholic domestic traditions.

A reported vision, weeping icon, or shrine visitation is not equivalent to juridical recognition of supernatural origin; 2025 DDF nihil obstat for Litmanová permits worship but does not establish supernatural authenticity.
Source-reported historic relic custody does not establish independent authentication or 2026 public access.
No fabricated coordinates, route polylines, future schedules, biographies, photos, or premature maps.
